spans.s:
श्येत-कोलक (कः) 1.
m. A sort of fish.

श्येन (नः) 1.
m. A hawk, a falcon;
whiteness, violence
f. (-ई) A
female hawk; a kind of metre.

श्येन-करण (णं) 1.
n. Acting rashly;
burning on a separate pile.
Also श्येन-करणिका.

श्येन-चित् (त्) 5.
m. A hawk feeder
[]
or keeper; a hawk-like recep-
tacle for sacrificial fire.

श्येन-जीविन् (वी) 5.
m. Who lives
by selling hawks.

श्येनो_पदेश (शः) 1.
m. Ordering a
woman to burn on a separate
funeral pile.
